description: A lab-local SSRF: the webhook preview fetches an attacker-supplied URL from the lab server without an allowlist.

evidence.response: 200 OK, lab metadata document in the body
evidence.notes: Lab-local fixture traffic only; the metadata endpoint is a lab stub, not a cloud service

impact: An attacker could make the lab server fetch internal lab endpoints and return their contents.
proof_of_concept: POST /lab/webhook-preview {url: http://169.254.169.254/lab/metadata} returns the lab metadata document in the response.
remediation: Allowlist preview URLs to public lab hosts and block link-local ranges.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the lab metadata document in the preview response
title: SSRF in lab webhook preview
